name: Admin payment settings are published to checkout
description: Verify the authenticated payment settings page and public checkout settings endpoint expose the same live seed configuration.

planSteps.description: Navigate directly to /masuk, fill Email with admin@rafstore.id, fill Password with Admin#Raf2026, and click Masuk.
Verify Raf Store Admin is visible after login.
Verify Pengaturan pembayaran is visible, Rekening aktif is 2, Langkah panduan is 4, and Metode is Transfer manual.
Verify the JSON response contains totals with accounts=2 and instructions=4, proving checkout reads the live payment configuration.
